name: Box transform and handle hit
description: Transform/BoxMath.swift: LayerTransform (scale, degrees, move) and BoxMath (resize by an EditorHandle with Shift aspect and Option centre, at least 1 and never flipping; several items scaled as one box; 15 degree rotate snap; the handle rects). Transform/HandleHit.swift: HandleHit (the handle under a point, Chebyshev with corners winning ties; a screen tolerance divided by zoom). Stubs from EK-3; bodies EK-20.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
